author: CrashCourse
description:
Is the Electoral College broken? More and more people in the U.S. are voicing dissatisfaction with the way we elect presidents. In this episode, we’ll unpack how the Electoral College works, why some people think it doesn’t work, and possible solutions to make our elections work better.

Chapter 1 - Introduction: The Electoral College 0:00
Chapter 2 - Picking Electors 3:19
Chapter 3 - The Electoral College Controversy 5:54
Chapter 4 - Fixing the Electoral College 9:29
Chapter 5 - Review & Credits 13:04

Sources: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1naWmymw68W9x6GAix9e4jTrEIRXT0-F3IniP3LSscOo/edit?tab=t.0
